summary: Ellington Credit Company filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, announcing its Board of Trustees declared a monthly common distribution of $0.08 per share, payable October 30, 2026 to shareholders of record as of September 30, 2026. This is a routine REIT distribution declaration, not a special situation, with no strategic or structural changes. No advisor was named. The dividend reflects the REIT's ordinary capital return policy, and investors should focus on sustainable earnings coverage and monthly payout consistency rather than event-driven arbitrage. Monitor net interest spread and portfolio credit trends.
